csv_scope_of_work: The City of Fayetteville is soliciting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified firms to provide professional design and installation services for a new playground at Veterans Memorial Park. The City of Fayetteville, hereinafter referred to as the City , seeks proposals from properly licensed professionals ( firm or Proposer ) who are able to recommend, provide, and properly layout and install age appropriate playground equipment to replace aging play equipment at Veterans Memorial Park, and any other related work required to create an upgraded, new playground.
